name: Papokin
author: lilalexmed@proton.me
description: Papokin 是一款完全用 Rust 编写的 Minecraft 服务器（Pumpkin 的分支），提供快速、高效、可定制的体验。它优先保障性能与玩家体验，同时遵循游戏核心机制。

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eux

apk add --no-cache curl jq
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64)
        PAPOKIN_ARCH="X64"
        ;;
    aarch64|arm64)
        PAPOKIN_ARCH="ARM64"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

BINARY_NAME="papokin-${PAPOKIN_ARCH}-Linux-musl"

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    URL="$DOWNLOAD_URL"
elif [ "${VERSION:-nightly}" = "latest" ] || [ "${VERSION:-nightly}" = "nightly" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_PACKAGE:-Quotidietium/Papokin}/releases/download/nightly/${BINARY_NAME}"
else
    URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_PACKAGE:-Quotidietium/Papokin}/releases/download/${VERSION}/${BINARY_NAME}"
fi

echo "Downloading Papokin from: $URL"
curl -fsSL "$URL" -o /mnt/server/papokin
chmod +x /mnt/server/papokin

# Quickly start and kill server to generate initial configuration if not present
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/papokin.toml ]; then
    timeout 2 ./papokin || true
fi
